chapters.title: Chapter 151: Ji Ge's sneer
paragraphs: "Finally detected Ji Ruxue's trail!"
"I want to see where you can escape!?"
The fat military commander looked happy, and immediately picked up the disc to interpret the location information of the light spot.
However, this interpretation immediately surprised him!
Because he discovered that the spot of light representing Ji Ruxue was moving towards Dongfang City!
"What the hell?"
"How could Ji Ruxue go to Dongfang City?"
"That's my Ji family's home court! How can you go to die?"
The fat military commander murmured in disbelief, "What the is going on?"
After being shocked for a long time, the fat military commander really couldn't figure out why Ji Ruxue chose to go to Eastern City.
So, after thinking about it again and again, he still took out the Jade Chuanshi.
Oriental City, Juewu Mountain.
Ji Ge was sitting cross-legged in the quiet room.
Suddenly, his expression changed, and he took out the jade medallion of passing letter.
The report on the jade card was exactly the report sent by the fat military commander.
When he saw the information displayed on the Chuanxin Jade Plate, he was suddenly shocked.
"Ji Ruxue is moving to Eastern City?"
Ji Ge's face was surprised, and he immediately groaned, "With Ji Ruxue alone, she must be able to flee as long as she can.
But she is doing the opposite at this time. Who gave her this courage, that Su Lang? "
Thinking of this, Ji Ge became more determined the more he thought about it, his expression changed from astonishment to cold sneer.
"Hmph, knowing that Dongfang City is the home court of my Ji family, dare to rush in?"
"Do you think you can kill the two martial arts of my Ji family, and you can fight my entire Ji family"
"Hmph, since you are looking for death, then I will take your lives unceremoniously!"
Ji Ge sneered for a while, immediately picked up the Chuanxin Jade Tablet and issued the order:
"If the order is passed on, all the people sent out will return to Dongfang City!
In addition, send people to the airport to strictly search every Aura airship that landed. I want them to know what it means to cast a net! "
After the order was given, Ji's family immediately moved.
They began to mobilize the huge energy of the Ji family, preparing to search for every aura airship that was about to land.
However, their actions were blocked by the Eastern City Branch of the Budo Alliance.
At this moment, a Ji family warrior kneeled in front of Ji Ge and reported the news.
"what happened?"
"Obviously that Su Lang also killed Qin Hu, why did you stop me?"
Ji Ge's face became extremely ugly after receiving the news that his actions were blocked.
"Patriarch, it's a big man from the main city of Blue Star!"

The warrior kneeling on the ground replied tremblingly, "It is said that Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy came to recruit students, and Dongfang City was designated as the recruiting location to accept talented warriors from all over the world.
Therefore, the branch of the Budo Union specifically greeted us, and we must not interfere with the normal operation of the airport during the recent period! "
"Damn it! How could it be such a coincidence?"
Ji Ge frowned, the flames of anger in his eyes almost gushing out!
I thought that Ji Ruxue and Su Lang could be captured easily from the airport.
But now, it might be more troublesome to kill Ji Ruxue.
However, Ji Ge soon calmed down: "Humph! Even if you can't kill you in the airport, it's only a matter of time before you kill you!
The order is passed on, to give up searching the airport, but strictly pay attention to Ji Ruxue's movements, once you have the opportunity, do it immediately! "
"Yes!"
The warrior of the letter should be knocked, and immediately got up and retreated.
"Xuanyuan Wudao Academy enrolls students..."
Looking at the departing warrior, Ji Ge's expression gradually eased, "This is also an excellent opportunity for my Ji family, and I hope more people can enter."
Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy is the best martial arts academy on Blue Star!
This college has the best practice techniques in the world, the best practice treasures, the most practice resources, and the best instructors!
Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy has a history of more than a thousand years. I don't know how many martial arts experts have been trained.
Everyone who knows Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy doesn't want to go to study.
Of course, the conditions for entering Xuanyuan Wudao Academy are also very harsh!
Just the aptitude must be ‘extreme’ or higher, and 99.9% of the people are eliminated!
In addition, there are assessments of comprehension and so on. Once one of them fails to meet the standard, it is doomed to miss Xuanyuan Academy for life.

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Refining Xuanyun Jingyuehuo!
paragraphs: In a blink of an eye, most of the day passed.
The aura airship is getting closer and closer to the Eastern City.

And Su Lang didn't know anything about Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy destroying the Ji family's plan to stand by and wait for the rabbits, causing him to miss the face-to-face confrontation with the Ji family.
Of course, even if he knew it, he would smile completely at best
—— Holding the hole card of Swallowing Clone in his hand, he can be completely fearless and fearless!
At this moment, he is full of excitement in the countdown!
What countdown?
Of course it is the countdown to Refining Xuanyun Jingyuehuo!
Su Lang pulled down the last finger and exclaimed excitedly: "Come on!"
"Ding! Xuanyun Jingyue Fire has been refined, do you accept it immediately!"
"Receive now!"
Su Lang did not hesitate and immediately accepted Xuanyun Jingyue Fire.
The next moment, he felt a sudden cold in the palm of his right hand, a feeling of becoming cleaner!
"There must be an additional flame mark!"
Su Lang hooked the corner of his mouth and raised his right hand to take a look.
In the heart of his right hand, there was an extra month of white flame mark beside the mark of the green lotus dragon pattern fire.
A faint strange wave was spreading from above, covering Su Lang's whole body.
At the same time, Su Lang also understood all the characteristics of this Xuanyun Jingyue Fire.
Xuanyun Jingyue Fire is completely different from Qinglian Dragon Fire.
The green lotus dragon-patterned fire is a pure offensive flame, while it is an auxiliary alien fire.
Of course, this is not to say that the auxiliary type is inferior to the attack type.
On the contrary, many auxiliary different fires are more useful than attacking different fires.
And Xuanyun Jingyue Fire is a kind of strange fire that works very well.
Xuanyun Jingyue Fire can give the refiner two abilities.
First, the extremely powerful purifying power!
This power of purification can be regarded as a passive ability.
It can purify almost all toxins and filth, so that the owner has the characteristics of being non-toxic, non-polluting and so on.
And it can also purify the aura and make the aura more pure, which is extremely useful for breaking through the realm and improving combat power.
At this moment, Su Lang felt that his aura was gradually becoming more pure!
The hidden dangers of the spiritual energy caused by the original use of the medicine are all wiped out!
Xuanyun Jingyuehuo's second ability is'Aura Extinguishment'!
This ability can obliterate the owner's breath, leaving it in a completely hidden state from the breath level!
This is almost a magical skill for an assassin-type warrior!
At the same time, this function is also the reason why Ji Ruxue risked her life to try to refine Xuanyun Jingyuehuo.
She wants to obliterate her own breath and get rid of the Ji family's pursuit!
"It's a strange fire, and the effect is against the sky!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth outlines an excited smile!
As a killer, Su Lang is very aware of the horror of poison.
Don't look at him now that he is very powerful, but when he encounters an intractable toxin, he still has to wait to die if there is no cure!
For example, the impermanent purple jade poison used by alchemist Tian Xiu before, Su Lang did not dare to try the poison.
In addition to being highly toxic, the power of filth is also very difficult!
It has many kinds of abnormalities. Once contaminated, it is like a tarsal maggot, gradually torturing the target to death, and many warriors have heard of it.
However, with Xuanyun Jingyue Fire at this time, Su Lang can ignore it directly, whether it is poisonous or dirty!
"Hmph, don't be afraid of any poison in the future, hehe!"
A smile was drawn at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, and immediately he got up and went outside Ji Ruxue's room.
"Little sister Ruxue, open the door!"
Su Lang knocked on the door and called in a low voice. At first glance, he looked a bit like a big bad wolf.
"Brother Su Lang!"
Ji Ruxue opened the door, eyes full of joy.
Granny Ke respectfully bowed to Su Lang, and immediately stood with her head down, as if I was a transparent person.
"Xuanyun Jingyuehuo I have refined it."
With a smile on his face, Su Lang said straightforwardly, "I'm looking for you just to kill your breath."
"Really? Brother Su Lang is so amazing!"
When Ji Ruxue heard that Su Lang had refined Xuanyun Jingyue Fire, she immediately admired her!
"Haha, of course it's amazing!"
Su Lang laughed, and then pointed his finger, a trace of moon-white flame emerged.
"Is this Xuanyun Jingyuehuo? So beautiful!"
Ji Ruxue watched the flames on Su Lang's fingers intently.

chapters.title: Chapter 153: Arrive at Oriental City
paragraphs: "Well, this is Xuanyun Jingyuehuo."
"I will extinguish your breath now, don't move, it won't hurt."
Su Lang soothed, and then gently brushed, Xuanyun Jingyue fire fell on Ji Ruxue's body.
As soon as the moon-white flame touched Ji Ruxue's skin, it immediately formed a faint mark on it.
In the next moment, Ji Ruxue's breath completely disappeared.
If it is a weaker warrior, even if he walks directly in front of Ji Ruxue, he may not be able to notice her existence.
"Brother Su Lang, you are so great, they will never find me again!"
Ji Ruxue stroked the flame mark, her face blushed with joy, smiling Qiuyue!
The feeling of being monitored at any time is really uncomfortable, and it would be very annoying to change anyone.
This feeling disappeared at this time, and Ji Ruxue was of course happy.
And just when the breath of Ji Ruxue's body disappeared.
On another aura airship, the disk responsible for detecting Ji Ruxue's trace suddenly flashed, and the light spot on it suddenly disappeared.
"Is it unstable again?"
The fat military commander glanced at the disc, frowning slightly.
Patriarch Ji Ge just said that he should keep an eye on Ji Ruxue's trail, and he disappeared in a blink of an eye. He couldn't explain it at all.
However, there is no alternative.
Who makes the quality of the disc so rubbish? Everything has to be blamed on that refiner!
The fat military commander thought silently, and even put the matter aside.
In his opinion, the light spot will appear again soon.
However, borrowing him for a hundred heads, he never expected that Ji Ruxue's aura had been extinguished by Su Lang with Xuanyun Jingyue Fire!
And the light spot on the disc will never appear again!
Three or four hours passed in a blink of an eye.
The Oriental City finally appeared where the heaven and the earth met.
As the distance gets closer and closer, the entire horizon is occupied by Eastern City, which shows how huge it is!
In addition to being larger than a city like Nanlin City, the prosperity of Dongfang City is also incomparable to Nanlin City.
I saw the high-rise buildings in the city like a steel jungle, densely packed, countless.
On the criss-crossing streets, a large number of Aura cars flowed incessantly, and even small Aura vehicles shuttled back and forth in the sky.
All this looks even like a peaceful city in the future!
Everything looks like a peaceful city in the future!
"This is the real big city."
Su Lang stood in front of the window and praised, "Compared with Dongfang City, Nanlin City is not enough to see, and Red Maple City's stronghold is directly reduced to a rural village!"
At this time, there was a pleasant radio sound outside.
It is also welcome to let you apply for an identity card.
Su Lang ignored it, then took out a white smiling fox mask and put it on his face.
Because he didn't plan to face the Ji family head-on, Su Lang decided to hide in the dark and give Ji family some color first.
And if you hide your face and extinguish your breath, you don't have to worry about Ji family coming to the door anymore.
After putting on the mask, Su Lang went outside Ji Ruxue's room.
Just about to knock on the door, the door opened.
"Brother Su Lang!"
Ji Ruxue yelled sweetly, and Xuan even obediently walked to Su Lang's side.
At this time she was wearing a white cloak, and her whole body was covered in clothing.
Granny Ke on the side also made a disguise, completely unable to see the way she was before.
"Let's go when everything is ready."
Su Lang nodded, leading Ji Ruxue's servant to get off the airship.
Mixing in the crowd, Su Lang found that there are not a few people who pretend to be like them.
"I was worried that this outfit was a bit dazzling, but now it seems that I have been overly worried."
Su Lang smiled faintly, and left the airport with the two.
"Ruxue, do you know where to buy pills?"
Walking on the road, Su Lang asked softly, "I have a lot of pills to sell here, and I plan to buy some alchemy materials."

chapters.title: Chapter 154: Stay on your side
paragraphs: Alchemy is a super profitable business, especially for Su Lang!
Because he doesn't need to do it himself, he only needs to prepare alchemy prescriptions and materials, and he can make alchemy every second!
Therefore, Su Lang intends to use one-key alchemy to make a fortune in Dongfang City!
"There are many places to buy pills in Dongfang City!"
Ji Ruxue smiled, "For example, the Jingxin Pill Building in front is one of them.
The reputation of this shop is very good. Brother Su Lang's perfect medicine can be sold to them with confidence! "
"If that's the case, then listen to you and go to the Meditation Pill."
Su Lang smiled and nodded, and then walked to the Jingxin Pill Building under the leadership of Ji Ruxue.
Not long after, the Jingxin Tower appeared in front of him.
This is a huge wooden building several hundred meters high, like a mansion!
Moreover, this wooden building has a long history and profound heritage.
"It looks good, I don't know how the service is?"
Su Lang nodded slightly, and then walked in with the two of them.
As soon as I entered the hall, my ears became quiet, seemingly cut off from the noisy world outside.
"Hello, buy a pill?"
A waitress in a light-colored uniform came up and asked respectfully.
"Sorry, I don't buy medicinal pills."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "I'm here to sell pills."
"Okay, please follow me.
The waitress was not surprised, nodded politely, and walked forward to lead the way.
The three Su Lang followed, and soon came to a room.
There are two people sitting opposite each other in this room.
One of the middle-aged strong men waited silently, while the gray-haired general-level old man was checking the medicine.
Regarding the arrival of Su Lang and others, the two of them in the room just glanced at them, and then ignored them.
"The gray-haired old man is Lao Li, who is responsible for purchasing pills."
"You can sit by and take a break, and it will be your turn soon."
The waitress introduced a few words, then bowed slightly, turned and left.
"sit down."
Su Lang sat in a chair leisurely.
Seeing this, Ji Ruxue ran to him and sat down next to him.
As for Granny Ke, she stood with her head down respectfully.
At this time, the old Li and the middle-aged strong man had a few conversations, and the deal was successfully concluded.
"It's time for us."
After the middle-aged strong man left, Su Lang stood up and was about to step forward.
But at this moment.
"Hahahaha.
With a burst of laughter, a person walked in wildly outside.
This man is a big fat man who is like a pregnant woman in August.
The bells and whistles and jewels he wore on him looked like a vulgar outburst.
Lao Li smiled and said, "Master Xu, I know it is you when I hear your laughter."
This Alchemy Master Xu has sold medicinal pills many times, and every time it is a big business, Lao Li welcomes him very much.
"Lao Li, I have made a lot of pills this time. You want to give me a good price!"
The big fat man laughed and walked straight to Lao Li.
"Hold on."
Su Lang's expression became cold, and he said unceremoniously, "I'm here first, stay on your side!"
"what?"
The big fat Master Xu Dan looked at him for a moment, then sneered at Su Lang: "Listen to your voice, isn't it less than twenty?
How many alchemists are you? What are the orders of the pills on your body? Isn't the quality all inferior? "
"I have a few grade alchemy masters, what kind of pill do I sell, what does it matter to you?" Su Lang said coldly.
"Humph! Even a young alchemist like you dare to come to Jingxin Pill House to sell pills?"
Danshi Xu coldly snorted, and said disdainfully, "Do you know that there is no charge for non-medium pill or higher?
Hurry up with your miscellaneous pill and get out, lest you get rejected by Lao Li, and you won't be able to hang on your face! "

Therefore, Su Lang intends to use one-key alchemy to make a fortune in Dongfang City!
"There are many places to buy pills in Dongfang City!"
Ji Ruxue smiled, "For example, the Jingxin Pill Building in front is one of them.
The reputation of this shop is very good.
Brother Su Lang's perfect medicine can be sold to them with confidence!
"If that's the case, then listen to you and go to the Meditation Pill."
Su Lang smiled and nodded, and then walked to the Jingxin Pill Building under the leadership of Ji Ruxue.
Not long after, the Jingxin Tower appeared in front of him.
This is a huge wooden building several hundred meters high, like a mansion!
Moreover, this wooden building has a long history and profound heritage.
"It looks good, I don't know how the service is?"
Su Lang nodded slightly, and then walked in with the two of them.
As soon as I entered the hall, my ears became quiet, seemingly cut off from the noisy world outside.
"Hello, buy a pill?"
A waitress in a light-colored uniform came up and asked respectfully.
"Sorry, I don't buy medicinal pills."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "I'm here to sell pills."
"Okay, please follow me.
The waitress was not surprised, nodded politely, and walked forward to lead the way.
The three Su Lang followed, and soon came to a room.
There are two people sitting opposite each other in this room.
One of the middle-aged strong men waited silently, while the gray-haired general-level old man was checking the medicine.
Regarding the arrival of Su Lang and others, the two of them in the room just glanced at them, and then ignored them.
"The gray-haired old man is Lao Li, who is responsible for purchasing pills."
"You can sit by and take a break, and it will be your turn soon."
The waitress introduced a few words, then bowed slightly, turned and left.
"sit down."
Su Lang sat in a chair leisurely.
Seeing this, Ji Ruxue ran to him and sat down next to him.
As for Granny Ke, she stood with her head down respectfully.
At this time, the old Li and the middle-aged strong man had a few conversations, and the deal was successfully concluded.
"It's time for us."
After the middle-aged strong man left, Su Lang stood up and was about to step forward.
But at this moment.
"Hahahaha.
With a burst of laughter, a person walked in wildly outside.
This man is a big fat man who is like a pregnant woman in August.
The bells and whistles and jewels he wore on him looked like a vulgar outburst.
Lao Li smiled and said, "Master Xu, I know it is you when I hear your laughter."
This Alchemy Master Xu has sold medicinal pills many times, and every time it is a big business, Lao Li welcomes him very much.
"Lao Li, I have made a lot of pills this time.
You want to give me a good price!"
The big fat man laughed and walked straight to Lao Li.
"Hold on."
Su Lang's expression became cold, and he said unceremoniously, "I'm here first, stay on your side!"
"what?"
The big fat Master Xu Dan looked at him for a moment, then sneered at Su Lang: "Listen to your voice, isn't it less than twenty?
How many alchemists are you?
What are the orders of the pills on your body?
Isn't the quality all inferior?
"I have a few grade alchemy masters, what kind of pill do I sell, what does it matter to you?" Su Lang said coldly.
"Humph!
Even a young alchemist like you dare to come to Jingxin Pill House to sell pills?"
Danshi Xu coldly snorted, and said disdainfully, "Do you know that there is no charge for non-medium pill or higher?
Hurry up with your miscellaneous pill and get out, lest you get rejected by Lao Li, and you won't be able to hang on your face!

chapters.title: Chapter 155: I made this bet
paragraphs: "Master Xu, right?"
A sneer appeared on Su Lang's face:
"Just because I'm young, you think I don't have high-end and high-quality pill, which is too ridiculous."
"Hmph, you are a stinky little brat, can you still be a high-level alchemist?"
Master Xu Dan glanced at Su Lang from above, "I guess, it would be great for you to be a third-rank alchemist.
You are a little low-level alchemist, what kind of pill can you have? "
In fact, there is nothing wrong with Xu Danshi's conjecture on ordinary people.
Even Lao Li, who was in charge of examining the pill, thought so.
A young warrior who spends most of his energy and time just in cultivation, how could he be a high-level alchemist?
However, they broke their heads and never thought that Su Lang was not only an alchemist, but also a tenth-grade alchemist!
"Hahahaha!"
Su Lang laughed dismissively, "Since you think I don't have a decent pill, why don't we make a bet?"
"Gamble, gamble!"
Dan Master Xu said proudly, "Whatever you bet on, I am still afraid that you, the little alchemist, will fail?"
"This bet is very simple."
Su Lang said faintly, "We are here to compare the total value of the medicine in someone's body.
The loser pays the other party's entire net worth. If you hear clearly, it is all net worth! "
As soon as this remark came out, Xu Danshi was stunned, and Lao Li also twitched the corners of his mouth.
"Is this kid crazy?"
"The total value of the pill is higher than who?"
"A low-rank alchemist, a high-rank alchemist, isn't this obvious?
"You don't need to compare and know that the total value of the pills in the high-rank alchemist must be higher!"
"Does this guy replace which high-level alchemist to sell pill?"
"It's impossible. Refining the pill is so difficult. Who would easily hand the pill to a young man to sell it?"
A lot of thoughts flashed through their minds for an instant.
Soon.
"Okay, it's better than this!"
A sneer appeared on the face of Master Xu Dan.
His alchemist Xu is also a famous eighth-order alchemist in Dongfang City.
He was very familiar with the entire circle of Eastern City alchemists, and had never heard of any young high-rank alchemists.
And the other party is unlikely to sell Dan on his behalf.
Even if it is, then his pill Master Xu is not afraid, because he has stored the pill for three months this time!
"and many more!"
"Little brother, forget it."
Lao Li suddenly smiled and stood up, "Since you came first, I will look at your pill first. There is no need to bet like that."
In his opinion, Su Lang, a small warrior, lacks enough cultivation resources.
If you lose all your net worth because of a momentary use of qi, isn't it going to drink the Northwestern wind?
As an old man, he couldn't see it.
Moreover, Su Lang did come first. According to the rules, he also had to look at Su Lang's medicine first.
"Old man, thank you for your kindness."
Of course, Su Lang saw Lao Li's intentions and smiled faintly, "However, I've made this bet!"
For Xu Danshi, this defiant fellow, Su Lang would definitely teach a lesson.
By the way, if you some money from him, you should make extra money!
"Humph! Originally I wanted to see Lao Li's face letting you off."
Master Xu Dan snorted, "But since you don't know what is good or bad, then I will let you lose upside down. Don't regret it then!"
"Tsk tusk, it's really a sure win!"
There was a faint sneer on Su Lang's face, "Come on, take out all your pills, and under the witness of the old gentleman, we will fight each other!"
"Cut, take it out and scare you to death!"
Master Xu Dan raised his nostrils disdainfully, and immediately waved his hand, and the table was suddenly filled with densely packed pills of medicine bottles.
"so much!?"
Seeing this scene, Lao Li exclaimed in surprise.
At the same time, he looked at Su Lang with a trace of pity.
In his opinion, Su Lang is definitely defeated!
Because the last time he acquired so many elixirs at once was more than half a year ago.
It can be seen that there are indeed a lot of this medicine!
"How? Afraid? It's late!"
Master Xu Dan looked at Su Lang contemptuously, "Now, take out your pill.
Although your pill must be very rubbish, I am happy to accept it. "

chapters.title: Chapter 156: I only make perfect pills
paragraphs: "It's really short-sighted, and this pill is so complacent?"
"Keep your dog's eyes wide open and take a good look, what is really more!"
Su Lang curled his lips in disdain, and with a thought, he took out all the pills in the storage space.
Suddenly, a small hill of pill pill appeared in the corner of the room!
And the top of this pill hill is almost rushing to the ceiling!
"what is this!?"
"Mountain of pill pills?"
Both Xu Danshi and Lao Li opened their eyes suddenly, and their eyes were about to fall out!
They really couldn't believe that a young alchemist could come up with so many pills!
"This...this...how can you have so many pills?"
Master Xu Dan was horrified, and his whole person was so shocked that he couldn't even speak clearly.
And at this moment, Lao Li on the side suddenly let out a cry of exhaustion!
"Oh my God--!"
Shaking all over, he pointed to the pill hill in disbelief, "That is...that is...the perfect quality pill!
Almost all of them are perfect-quality pill, and they are piled on the ground so without pity, there is not even a pill bottle!
Oh my god, is my eyes broken or the world is broken! ? "
Old Li's exclamation fell in the ears of Danshi Xu, directly causing his horror to skyrocket again.
"What? A pill of perfect quality?
"Lao Li, what are you kidding? It's impossible!"
Pill Master Xu said in disbelief, while his stiff head looked at the pill hill.
But this look immediately made him feel demented.
"This...this is really a pill of perfect quality!"
"How come... how come there are so many perfect quality pills!?"
"This is not true, these pills must be all fake! Yes, they are all fake!"
Xu Danshi screamed hoarsely when he saw a ghost!
Although he knew that those pills were absolutely perfect quality, he really didn't believe it!
You know, he has never refined the pill of perfect quality for the whole life.
The only time to refine the best grade 8 pill, it made him happy for half a year!
But now, the perfect pill that he couldn't refine his whole life, unexpectedly appeared a lot like ordinary goods, which made him unable to accept it anyway!
"So scared like this with a little pill?"
Su Lang scorned Xu Danshi indifferently, "It's really rubbish, rubbish."
"You are the waste!"
"This can't be the pill you refined!"
Pill Master Xu's eyes were red, and he screamed, "Yes, it is absolutely impossible for you to refine so many perfect quality pill, you got it from other places!"
"What you said is true."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "I didn't really refine many of the pills in it."
"I know it, I know it!"
As expected, Danshi Xu said with a face, "How can a young man like you refine a pill of perfect quality!
"Hey, I haven't finished speaking yet!"
Su Lang chuckled and continued, "Those top-grade, top-grade, and middle-grade pills are indeed not made by me. I am a person who only refines perfect-quality pills!"
"You, you, you, how dare you say this!? You are not afraid that the wind will flash your tongue!?"
Master Xu Dan's face flushed, and he pointed to Su Lang tremblingly, "If you can really make a perfect quality pill, I will eat this table!"
With that, he slapped Lao Li's table with a slap.
"Yo, eat the table?"
There was a hint of playfulness on Su Lang's face, and he immediately turned to look at Ji Ruxue:
"Little sister Ruxue, do you want to watch the performance of the fat man eating the table?"
"Yes I do!"
Ji Ruxue quickly smiled and nodded.
For the unreasonable Xu Danshi, she had long wanted to clean up!
"Well, I'll let him act for you!"
Su Lang smiled, then looked at Xu Danshi with sarcasm:
"Fatty man, if I make a perfect pill, you will not fulfill the punishment.
Then I will make a hole in your head and stuff the table in! "
Looking at Su Lang, who was so stubborn, and listening to the murderous words, Xu Danshi's heart felt bad, and he slapped a violent spirit.
However, it is impossible to ask him to admit it!

chapters.title: Chapter 157: I'm so shocked that I can't stand still
paragraphs: "If you can't refine it, then you eat the table too!"
Master Xu Dan swallowed hard and said viciously.
"Hahaha!"
Su Lang glanced at Pill Master Xu contemptuously, "If I lose, I will not only eat the table, but also give you all my pills."
"Okay! It's a deal!"
Of course Xu Danshi wished to be so.
Su Lang no longer looked at Pill Master Xu, and directly took out the pill furnace.
"boom!"
A round pill furnace fell to the ground, and there was a loud noise.
Seeing this pill furnace, Pill Master Xu and Lao Li were shocked at the same time.
"It turned out to be a tenth-order pill furnace!"
"How can this kid have such a precious pill furnace?"
"What on earth is he coming from? Could it be that he is really a super-powerful alchemist and failed?"
The bad things in Xu Danshi's heart grew thicker, and Lao Li's gaze at Su Lang became more shocking!
"Snapped!"
Su Lang snapped his fingers, and a black flame emerged out of thin air, wrapping the pill furnace.
Because the temperature of the Qinglian dragon pattern fire was too high, Su Lang simply chose the weaker Meteorite Black Flame.
Immediately afterwards, as everyone watched, Su Lang randomly chose a Tier 6 pill.
As soon as he started refining, Master Xu and Lao Li's eyes widened!
Because every move of Su Lang is too perfect!
No flaws can be found at all!
Master Xu Dan just watched it for a while, and he felt a lot of gains, and a sense of embarrassment gradually grew in his heart.
But soon his shame was turned into a strong sense of shame.
Because in any case he didn't want to believe that his life's hard work was no better than a yellow-haired kid!
"The technique looks okay, but it doesn't mean that you can refine the perfect pill!"
"When I refine the low-level pill, the technique is the same, there is no defect, and I don't necessarily refine the perfect quality pill!"
"This kid, refuses to be able to refine the perfect pill!"
Master Xu Dan stared at Su Lang closely, a sneer gradually appeared on his face.
And the next scene made him sure of his own thoughts.
Because he discovered that Su Lang had already begun the final pill condensing step!
"Starting to condense the pill so soon, it will be difficult for this pill to be discarded!"
Master Xu Dan was secretly refreshed, "Huh! You dare to make a bet with me, I don't know how high the world is!"
On the other side, Lao Li was also unbelievable that Su Lang had begun to concentrate so quickly.
As a professional alchemist, he is also a senior alchemist.
Under normal circumstances, it takes two hours for him to refine the pill before he dared to start condensing the pill. If he condense the pill so quickly, the pill will definitely be useless!
"What is going on with this little brother?"
Lao Li frowned deeply, "Obviously the technique is so high-end and perfect, but so eager for success?"
At this moment, Su Lang pointed his finger, the furnace stopped rotating and the furnace lid opened automatically!
"Finished?"
"Needless to say, it must be a waste!"
Xu Danshi sneered and looked at the pill furnace.
The scene where Su Lang handed out the pill and ate the table with tears was almost in his mind.
However, when he saw the pill in the pill furnace, the sneer on his face instantly solidified!
I saw five pills that were still exuding residual warmth lying quietly in the furnace!
Each of these five medicinal pills is crystal clear, without any flaws, just like the most beautiful orb in the world!
"Perfect quality Yuanyang Ji Ling Dan! And it's-five!!!"
Lao Li on the side couldn't help screaming, his whole body was so shocked that he couldn't stand still!
At the same time, Xu Danshi's reaction was even more exaggerated!
"It's impossible!"
"It's only a few minutes, how can it be possible to condense the pill successfully, how can it be possible to refine the pill of perfect quality, and it is still five!"
"It's not true, God, it's not true, it's all false, everything is false!"
"Yes! This is an illusion, this is definitely an illusion, who is it? Who gave me the medicine?"
Xu Danshi lost consciousness, his face was demented, his body trembled, and his soul was almost gone.
"Snapped!"
Suddenly a slap in the face slapped his face severely.
In an instant, Danshi Xu's fat face became fatter.
And it's bright and barking, as if it would explode with a needle poke!

chapters.title: Chapter 158: Eat the table for me immediately
paragraphs: "Please take up the courage to face reality?"
Su Lang slowly retracted his palm, his eyes full of disdain when he looked at Alchemist Xu.
The severe pain caused Alchemy Xu to wake up. He covered his face and stared at Su Lang blood red: "You... how dare you hit me!?"
Since becoming an alchemist, as his rank has become higher and higher, Master Xu has rarely even looked at others' faces.
But now he was actually slapped in the face, and he was still in front of acquaintances, which is simply a shame!
"You have a bite of milk and smelly, and a bite of a yellow-haired child, you are not allowed to beat you?"
Su Lang smiled coldly, "I'm telling you, before I changed my job, I just slapped you off, and slapped you on the face. You got the bargain!"
"you you!"
"I killed you so much!"
Danshi Xu's temples were violently blue, and he smashed against Su Lang fiercely with his white fist.
"stop!"

chapters.title: Chapter 166: Fake reputation
paragraphs: "Not negotiable!"
"Exchanging endless spirit stones for a pile of shit, stupid talent!"
"Furthermore, do you think I don't know Xu Zhifei is yours?"
Su Lang sneered and waved his hand, "We have already had enemies. Your so-called sincerity is nothing more than talking.
What do you plan in your heart, everyone knows well, why do you perform awkwardly there like a clown? "
As soon as this remark came out, Jing Qianye and others were surprised.
They didn't expect that Su Lang would have known that Xu Zhifei was in the same group with them.
"Humph--!!"
"Originally, if you agreed, I might not let you go!"
"But since you are toasting and not eating fine wine, then I don't bother to be polite to you!"
"Today you not only have to hand over that magical alchemy, but you also have to kneel down and apologize for my Alchemy Master Qianyige!"
Jing Qianyi clapped his hands murderously, and there was a sound of hula-la footsteps outside!
In a blink of an eye, a junior military commander came in with a large number of generals, and the whole hall was blocked!
Xu Zhifei also squeezed out from the crowd.
"Hahahaha!"
"Hear no, the stinky dog byproducts, immediately kneel down and apologize!"

Xu Zhifei's face was distorted and his eyes were stern, "Otherwise, I will let you taste torture, and then ask Master Jing Qianyi to refine you into a hundred-refining pill, so that you will be eaten by others, and finally become a shit!"
"Tsk tusk, what a big battle, I'm so scared!"
Su Lang put on a look of horror, "Especially that one hundred refinement pill!
Is it to refine people alive to make a pill? So weird, so vicious, it must be so painful! "
"Hahaha, you guessed it!"
Jing Qianyi hung his eyelids and looked at Su Lang aloft, "Refining the human pill is the highest achievement of my life.
With this method, a martial artist can be made alive into a pill, which can be used to improve the cultivation qualifications and cultivation levels of others.
In the process of alchemy, the recipient will endure endless pain, and the total amount of the eighteen layers of Asura is nothing more than that!
Young man, if you don't surrender your alchemy, don't blame me for using this cruel method against you! "
Speaking of this, including Jing Qianyi's henchmen, almost all the warriors couldn't help but shudder!
Hundred Lian Ren Dan is really cruel!
No one who has seen alchemy scenes does not have nightmares!
"It's so cruel!"
"Unexpectedly, King Jing Dan, who is respected by so many people, secretly has such a fake reputation and stinks!"
The panic on Su Lang's face turned into a sneer, "But that's okay, then, when I kill you, I won't have any psychological burden!"
"What!? He actually wanted to kill Master Jing Qianyi?"
"Is this little bit blind? Can he not see the situation clearly?"
"Where is he blind? This is madness, and only a madman can say such brazen words!
After being shocked by all Jing Qianyi's men, they all sneered at Su Lang.
In their opinion, Su Lang must be afraid to the extreme before saying such unconscious words!
"Young people, although you don't have a breath, it makes it difficult for me to see through your true cultivation."
Jing Qianyi said slowly, "But, is it possible that you can still be the three martial arts commanders!?
Humph! I will give you one last chance to hand over alchemy and become my slave. Li, I will spare your life!
Otherwise, you will taste all the pain in the world! "
Having said that, Jing Qianyi sneered, and a huge military commander aura spread out from his body.
The military commander and the generals who rushed in also released their aura and pressed down against the three of Su Lang.
However, the next moment, something shocking happened to them!
I saw that Su Lang and others had no reaction at all under the pressure of so many powerful men!
Not even the slightest change in his face!
"what happened!?"
"He is indifferent to our aura and oppression!?"
"Two military commanders plus dozens of military commanders' aura, even a prospective military commander will be frightened!"
A strong look of horror appeared on everyone's faces.
Jing Qianyi's face changed for a while, and immediately turned into a sneer again.

paragraphs: In his opinion, the opponent is so young, it is absolutely impossible to be a military commander.

"Pretend to be calm!"
Jing Qianyi sneered again and again, and waved his big hand, "Give me all, grab them first, I don't believe that I can't pry out the alchemy I want!"
"Catch them!"
"Let them taste our cruelty!"
Xu Zhifei's face was grim, and he was the first to rush up. His hatred for Su Lang was simply monstrous!
"Humph!"
"Really we have no one!"
Granny Ke let out an angry snort, and a powerful military commander aura burst out of her body.
In an instant, everyone's expressions changed drastically, and their movements stagnated.
That Xu Zhifei was even more horrified, and quickly retracted into the crowd!
"Unexpectedly, you really have a military commander-level powerhouse!"
Jing Qianyi's long and narrow old eyes narrowed into a slit, "But what about a military commander?
All the generals obeyed the order and surrounded Qian Yige, Qian Wushuai, you and me deal with her! "
As soon as his voice fell, all the generals retreated outside the door, surrounding the entire manor with no water or rain!
The military commander surnamed Qian took a deep breath, took a step forward and doubled Su Lang with Jing Qianyi.
In an instant, the murderous aura in the hall was freezing, and the atmosphere was almost freezing!
And just when the battle is about to start.
"Sister Ruxue, pour me a cup of tea."
Su Lang sat on the chair leisurely, waving his hand at Ji Ruxue lightly.
"Okay, Brother Su Lang!"
Ji Ruxue nodded obediently, picked up the teapot on the coffee table and started pouring tea.
These two ordinary words fell in the ears of Jing Qianyi and Qian Wushuai, and they suddenly thundered!
"Su Lang!!!"
"Ji Ruxue! Granny Ke!"
Jing Qianyi looked at Su Lang three people like he had seen a ghost, "It turned out to be the three of you!?"
"Oh?"
Su Lang raised his eyebrows, "Do you know us?"
"Humph!"
"Ji Ge and I worship brothers!"
Jing Qianyi snorted coldly, "Would I not know that you saved Ji Ruxue?
Unexpectedly, you would actually appear in front of me, it is really no effort to break through the iron shoes and find nowhere to find! "
"Tsk tusk, it turns out that you are in the same group with the Ji family!"
"In that case, you should know what Ji Kun lost to me."
Su Lang pouted his lips in disdain, "Do you think it's our opponents just with you two?"
"You are really good!"
"Ji Kun has the strength of the pinnacle military commander and is defeated in your hands, and we are just two junior military commanders."
Jing Qian also sneered without fear, "But do you think our strength is really so weak!?
Today, I will let you see how terrifying strength I can erupt as King Dan! "
After speaking, he immediately took out a pill to eat, and Qian Wushuai also took the pill.
The next moment, Jing Qianyi and Qian Wushuai exploded at the same time with a huge momentum comparable to the peak military commander.
"Hahahaha!"
"Su Lang child, are you scared!?"
Jing Qianyi looked up to the sky and laughed wildly, "Can you defeat a peak military commander, can you beat our two peak military commanders?
I advise you to kneel and surrender immediately and hand over the alchemy!
Then take the control pills I refined and become my slave. Li, so, I will let you live! "
"Hehe, take pills to improve your strength?"
"I thought it was a new method!"
Su Lang took a sip of tea calmly, and then said lightly, "Taking the pill to improve so much strength at once, the sequelae must be very severe, right?"
"The side effects are really serious!"
"But compared with your alchemy and your cherished slave Li, it's worth a thousand dollars!"
Jing Qianyi's long and narrow old eyes showed greed, "I don't want to talk nonsense with you, immediately hand over alchemy, and then become my slave. Li!"
"I don't want to talk nonsense with you."
Su Lang lightly took a sip of tea again, "Hand over all my wealth before I finish drinking tea, I will spare you a lot of fun!"
"Until now I still can't see the situation clearly, I really don't know how to live or die!"
Jing Qianyi completely lost his patience, his face became cold and he was about to do it immediately!
But at this moment!
Suddenly shouts of horror came from outside!

chapters.title: Chapter 168: I want to go to Tu Ji's house
paragraphs: "Ah! Ah!!!"
"who!?"
"Who would dare to break into Qianyi Pavilion!"
"So strong, they are so strong! No! Don't kill me!"
The cries of horror and begging for mercy were endless, like gongs and drums, deafening!
Jing Qianyi and Qian Wushuai changed their expressions, their eyes condensed, and they frowned and looked out.
Outside the gate, seven white-robed masked men slaughtered Qianyige warriors like death.
No matter what the realm of the warrior, they all fell like cutting wheat, and there was no resistance at all!
In an instant, the screams and begging for mercy outside became sparse.
"Help! Master Jing Qianyi!"
Xu Zhifei crawled into the hall, his face was full of panic and despair!
suddenly!
A white robe figure appeared behind him like a teleport!
"Huh!"
The sword light was like thunder, and like a dragon going out to sea, it cut through Xu Zhifei's limbs in an instant!
The terrified Xu Zhifei immediately felt that his hands and feet were not being used!
"what happened!?"
"Why can't my hands and feet move anymore!?"
Endless fears and doubts arose in Xu Zhifei's mind!
But the next moment, all his doubts disappeared, turning into fear and despair!
Because he felt severe pain coming from his limbs, his body immediately fell forward uncontrollably!
"Puff!
Xu Zhifei fell to the ground severely!
His arms and legs were scattered like building blocks, and the dazzling blood was ejected from the wound in the next moment!
"Ah! It hurts!!"
"My legs! My hands! My roots!!"
Xu Zhifei's face was distorted and he screamed hysterically. It sounded like his lungs were broken!
"It sounds worse than a pig, kill it."
Su Lang faintly waved his hand, and the white robe clone went down with a sword. The screams stopped abruptly, and Xu Zhifei separated his body and head!
At the same time, the noise outside disappeared completely.
The entire Qianyige Manor became completely silent, silent!
"Patter...Patter..."
A string of footsteps came.
The other six white robe masked men walked into the hall together, and came behind Su Lang with the previous one.
Seeing this scene, Jing Qianyi and Qian Wushuai immediately shrank their pupils, and a deep sense of misfortune rose in their hearts!
Because when the white-robed man moved his hands, they couldn't even see the other's movements clearly!
"Goooo!"
"You...who are you guys!?"
Jing Qianyi swallowed nervously, "How dare to slaughter my Qianyi Pavilion people wantonly in Eastern City, aren't you afraid of being wanted by the whole city?"
"What is Tu You Qianyi Pavilion?"
Su Lang dismissed playing with the teacup, "It won't be long before I will go to Tu Ji's house!"
"Tu Ji's family!?"
"You are really wishful thinking!
"Do you know that the Ji family is the real Wuwang family!"
Jing Qianyi gritted his teeth, "You are really strong, but in front of the Ji family, you are not worth mentioning!"
"Haha, it's not worth mentioning!?"
A sneer was drawn at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, "Then, let you see if we are not worth mentioning!"
He just finished speaking!
"boom--!!"
Seven terrifying Wu Wang-class auras rose to the sky, almost overturning the roof! !
"what!?"
"All of them are King Wu level!?"
"How is this possible! This is impossible!"
Both Jing Qianyi's complexion changed wildly, and they lost their voice in horror, and their hearts were almost torn apart!
They knew that the seven white robe masked men were very strong, but they never thought they were seven martial kings!
And these seven great martial kings are all standing behind that Su Lang as if they were subordinates!
OMG!
You must know that the strong in the realm of King Wu are all elders in the Ji family!
With King Wu as the guard, how terrifying is Su Lang's background! ?
"Look at it."
Su Lang stood up and sneered, "Are we not worth mentioning?"
"Puff!"
Qian Wushuai suddenly shocked all over and knelt on the ground!
"Master Su Lang, I was forced by Jing Qianyi!"
Qian Wushuai bowed down in horror and excitement, "He lied to me to take the poison pill, so I would die for him, I didn't mean to be your enemy!
Please... please kill Jing Qianyi, please save my life! "

Outside the gate, seven white-robed masked men slaughtered Qianyige warriors like death.
No matter what the realm of the warrior, they all fell like cutting wheat, and there was no resistance at all!
In an instant, the screams and begging for mercy outside became sparse.
"Help!
Master Jing Qianyi!"
Xu Zhifei crawled into the hall, his face was full of panic and despair!
suddenly!
A white robe figure appeared behind him like a teleport!
"Huh!"
The sword light was like thunder, and like a dragon going out to sea, it cut through Xu Zhifei's limbs in an instant!
The terrified Xu Zhifei immediately felt that his hands and feet were not being used!
"what happened!?"
"Why can't my hands and feet move anymore!?"
Endless fears and doubts arose in Xu Zhifei's mind!
But the next moment, all his doubts disappeared, turning into fear and despair!
Because he felt severe pain coming from his limbs, his body immediately fell forward uncontrollably!
"Puff!
Xu Zhifei fell to the ground severely!
His arms and legs were scattered like building blocks, and the dazzling blood was ejected from the wound in the next moment!
"Ah!
It hurts!!"
"My legs!
My hands!
My roots!!"
Xu Zhifei's face was distorted and he screamed hysterically.
It sounded like his lungs were broken!
"It sounds worse than a pig, kill it."
Su Lang faintly waved his hand, and the white robe clone went down with a sword.
The screams stopped abruptly, and Xu Zhifei separated his body and head!
At the same time, the noise outside disappeared completely.
The entire Qianyige Manor became completely silent, silent!
"Patter...Patter..."
A string of footsteps came.
The other six white robe masked men walked into the hall together, and came behind Su Lang with the previous one.
Seeing this scene, Jing Qianyi and Qian Wushuai immediately shrank their pupils, and a deep sense of misfortune rose in their hearts!
Because when the white-robed man moved his hands, they couldn't even see the other's movements clearly!
"Goooo!"
"You...who are you guys!?"
Jing Qianyi swallowed nervously, "How dare to slaughter my Qianyi Pavilion people wantonly in Eastern City, aren't you afraid of being wanted by the whole city?"
"What is Tu You Qianyi Pavilion?"
Su Lang dismissed playing with the teacup, "It won't be long before I will go to Tu Ji's house!"
"Tu Ji's family!?"
"You are really wishful thinking!
"Do you know that the Ji family is the real Wuwang family!"
Jing Qianyi gritted his teeth, "You are really strong, but in front of the Ji family, you are not worth mentioning!"
"Haha, it's not worth mentioning!?"
A sneer was drawn at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, "Then, let you see if we are not worth mentioning!"
He just finished speaking!
"boom--!!"
Seven terrifying Wu Wang-class auras rose to the sky, almost overturning the roof! !
"what!?"
"All of them are King Wu level!?"
"How is this possible!
This is impossible!"
Both Jing Qianyi's complexion changed wildly, and they lost their voice in horror, and their hearts were almost torn apart!
They knew that the seven white robe masked men were very strong, but they never thought they were seven martial kings!
And these seven great martial kings are all standing behind that Su Lang as if they were subordinates!
OMG!
You must know that the strong in the realm of King Wu are all elders in the Ji family!
With King Wu as the guard, how terrifying is Su Lang's background! ?
"Look at it."
Su Lang stood up and sneered, "Are we not worth mentioning?"
"Puff!"
Qian Wushuai suddenly shocked all over and knelt on the ground!
"Master Su Lang, I was forced by Jing Qianyi!"
Qian Wushuai bowed down in horror and excitement, "He lied to me to take the poison pill, so I would die for him, I didn't mean to be your enemy!
Please... please kill Jing Qianyi, please save my life!

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Reversal of twists and turns!
paragraphs: "Qian Mingwu!!"
"You bastard, don't you want to live anymore?"
Jing Qianyi yelled in surprise and anger, he never expected Qian Mingwu to turn aside!
"Roll Nima's egg!"
"I'm a big deal go to with you!"
Qian Wushuai, that is, Qian Mingwu's eye canthus is about to split, his eyes are blood-red and roar:
"You old man with so many books, how many innocent warriors have you killed in order to refine the human pill!"
Even me, it's the human pill material you prepared to break through the realm!
If it wasn't for the Ji family to get in touch with you and threaten my family, I would have died with you! "
His voice was piercing, and he didn't know how much hatred it contained.
"You dog stuff!"
"Do you think I dare not kill you?"
"I will kill you now!!"
Jing Qian also burst into the canthus, thunderous, and immediately stretched out his hand, and a blue smoke and dust melted into the air!
"Hahahaha!"
"You kill me, Master Su Lang will avenge me too!"
"Not only you, but also the Ji family, who is like a raccoon dog and a mess with you!"
"With the energy of Master Su Lang, you all have to die, hahahaha! Hahahaha!"
Qian Wushuai looked up to the sky and laughed long, like crazy, his laughter was stern and desperate, but with a cheerful meaning!
"Ha ha!"
At this time, Jing Qianyi suddenly became calm.
"Want to kill me?"
A sneer climbed up on his face again: "My dignified King Pill, how can there be no means to deal with King Wu!
Having said that, Jing Qianyi's pair of long and narrow old eyes fixed on Su Lang:
"Do you think the blue smoke was just to kill the military commander Qian?
Do not! That's the method against you Wuwang! That is Wan Zhuan Lan Yang Spirit Poison!
You are so careless, you didn't have any defense from beginning to end!
Now, as long as you dare to use your spiritual power, I promise you will die miserably! "
As soon as this remark came out, Qian Wushuai's expression suddenly changed!
He dared to rebel because Su Lang and others were powerful.
If Su Lang and others were recruited, wouldn't it be all over?
"No, this is not true!"
"You must be scaring people!"
Qian Wushuai's eyes widened, and he immediately tried to use his spiritual power.
next moment.
A lot of blood spots suddenly appeared on his body.
These blood spots are constantly expanding, decaying, and looking terrifying!
"It's over, it's really poisoned!"
Qian Wushuai's voice trembled and his face was desperate.
"Have you seen!"
"This is Wanzhuan Lanyang Spirit Poison, my original highly poisonous!"
Jing Qianyi smiled and looked at Su Lang, "You can kill me now, but after you kill me, you will never get the antidote.
What is the difference between you who cannot use your spiritual power and waste? It's not worthwhile to turn into a waste to kill me, right?
But now, I don’t want your alchemy, as long as you let me go now, I will definitely give you the antidote!
Today’s misunderstanding has never happened, I will leave Eastern City, and we will never see each other again!
My condition is so simple, it's not difficult to choose! "
In the end, Jing Qianyi almost looked confident and confident.
"Hey! Jing Qianyi, do you really think you're taking us?"
Su Lang sneered disdainfully, "Today, you don't want to leave alive anyway!"
As he said, Su Lang's heart moved, and the seven clones raised their right hands at the same time, and a vortex of spiritual energy emerged!
"Dare to use spiritual power, you are dead!"
Jing Qianyi sneered, looking at Su Lang as if looking at another dead person!
But the next moment, the sneer on his face gradually solidified!
Because he found that Su Lang did not show any signs of poisoning!
"how can that be!?"
Jing Qianyi yelled in disbelief, "My Ten Thousand Revolving Blue Sun Spirit Poison has never failed. What is going on!"
"Do you know that there is a strange fire in the world called Xuanyun Jingyue Fire!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, and a cloud of white flames emerged out of thin air and fell on Qian Wushuai.
In an instant, the blood spots on Qian Wushuai's body began to heal, and disappeared in no time.
"Xuanyun Jingyuehuo! No poison is invaded!"
Qian Wushuai looked shocked, and immediately showed endless excitement and ecstasy, "Thank you, Master Su Lang for detoxifying me, and thank Master Su Lang for your life-saving grace!!"
The trace of Xuanyun Jingyue Fire not only relieved the Ten Thousand Rank Blue Sun Spiritual Poison on his body, but also relieved the violent poison Jing Qianyi used to control him!
From now on, he completely got rid of Jing Qianyi's control, which made him ecstatic!
Compared with Qian Wushuai's ecstasy, Jing Qian is trembling and fearful!

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Give me a good time!
paragraphs: "How could this be!?"
"God, why do you treat me like this!"
"Why do you have Xuanyun Jingyue Fire!?"
Jing Qianyi screamed hysterically, and his whole body almost broke down!
Wan Zhuan Lan Yang Lingpo is his last hole card and his last hope for a comeback!
But now, his last hope is shattered!
All that is left for him is endless despair and fear under the threat of death!
"Jing Qianyi, do you want to die happily?"
Su Lang smiled faintly, and put the teacup on the table, "Before I drink my tea, take out all your wealth!"
"Do not!"
"My Dan Wang Jing Qianyi, I will never give in to you!"
Jing Qianyi yelled like crazy, "Even if you kill me, don't want to get all my wealth!"
"Master Su Lang!"
Qian Mingwu on the side suddenly smiled, "I know where his wealth is hidden.
After I was controlled by him, he never defended me.
He even took me to his treasure trove and treated me as an object to show off! "
As soon as he said this, Jing Qianyi's eyes stared, and he couldn't help but a mouthful of old blood came out of his mouth!
"Hahahaha!"
"Okay, great!"
Su Lang looked up to the sky and laughed wildly, "In this way, I can punish this old dog as much as I can!"
Immediately, his thoughts moved, and the two white robe clones disappeared into place in the blink of an eye.
"what!!"
Jing Qian also yelled in horror, his whole body was standing upside down, and his scalp was about to explode!
next moment.
"boom--!!"
A avatar punched his dantian, and a terrifying punch came out of his back, causing a gust of wind.
"Puff! My spiritual core!!"
Jing Qianyi spurted blood, his eyes burst open, his light dimmed
——He was scrapped!
But before he could recover from the shock of being dethroned, two invisible forces fell on his legs!
"Crack!"
There was a toothy fracture, and the pain instantly swept through Jing Qianyi's body!
"Ah!"
"Su Lang child, you must not die!"
Jing Qianyi knelt directly on the ground with a distorted face and cursed loudly with painful expression!
"Do you dare to scold me at this point?"
A sneer was drawn at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, "Let me delay him!"
"Swish!"
The two clones simultaneously drew sharp swords.
The shiny sword blade reflected the cold sword light, and the temperature in the entire hall dropped a lot.
"No! You can't do this!"
Jing Qian also saw this scene, the fear in his heart suddenly overwhelmed the hatred!
However, no one cares about his begging for mercy!
"Huh!"
A flash of sword light flashed!
A wound appeared on Jing Qianyi's chest!
"Huh!"
Before Jing Qianye screamed, another sword light fell, cutting a long wound on his back!
"Whhhhhhhh!"
The two clones were extremely fast, and the sharp sword light kept falling!
In an instant, every inch of Jing Qianyi's skin was covered with horrible sword wounds!
A large amount of blood stained Jing Qianye's tattered clothes and ran on the ground, forming a dazzling pool of blood!
"Ah!"
"Stop it, stop it! I know it's wrong!"
"Su Lang! Lord Su Lang! I was wrong, I shouldn't provoke you, please, give me a good time!"
Jing Qianyi screamed in pain, begging for mercy as if he had fallen into the sword mountain hell!
But Su Lang was completely indifferent.
For a villain like Jing Qianyi, it would be too cheap to kill him directly.
Even Ling Chi, in Qian Mingwu's eyes, was not enough to make Jing Qianyi atone for his crime.
Because he really killed too many people.
There are hundreds of them just made into human pill by him alive!
"Ah--! Kill me!"
"Su Langgou, you bastard, you kind of kill me!"
Jing Qian also saw that Su Lang turned a deaf ear to his begging for mercy, and immediately cursed with a stern face, trying to anger Su Lang and let him directly kill himself.
However, Su Lang didn't care about his clumsy aggressive strategy like this, and even wanted to laugh a little.
"Go on, give me Ling Chi 10,000 swords!"
Su Lang smiled faintly, "Then, we will start a new show!"
"New... new show!"
"No! Su Lang, you can't do this!"
"Ah! My skin! My meat! My bones!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Exhausted and difficult to count
paragraphs: After half an hour.
Jing Qian, who is not a man, took the last breath in pain and unwillingness.
"Ding!"
"You get a space ring*1, a low-grade spiritual stone*2362333, a medium-grade spiritual stone*225666, a high-grade spiritual stone*3656, and a Jade Heng Ning Bi Huang Dan*12..."
"Noisy, noisy, so many spirit stones!"
"How many digits do you need to change into gold coins!?"
The wonderful system prompt made Su Lang couldn't help but grow his mouth!
Immediately after he converted, these spirit stones were nearly 6.15 billion in gold coins!
"This net worth! Is already fifty times that of Ji Kun!"
"Made, worthy of being the number one alchemist in Eastern City, has so many spirit stones!"
Su Lang was so excited, "And this is not all his wealth!"
Thinking of this, Su Lang immediately looked at Qian Mingwu: "Qian Wushuai, you said you know Jing Qianyi's treasure, right?"
"Yes, Lord Su Lang!"
Qian Mingwu looked grateful and respectful, "I'll take the adults there!"
"Then go!"
Su Lang was full of excitement and couldn't wait to stand up.
"My lord, go here!"
Qian Mingwu bowed and immediately walked ahead to lead the way.
The Su Lang trio hurriedly followed.
Not long after, a group of people appeared in a huge basement under Qianyi Pavilion.
This basement is extremely large, occupying a full five acres of land!
In the center of the basement, there is a two-story black pill furnace, and there is a nasty smell of blood.
"This is the pill furnace Jing Qianyi uses to refine the human pill!"
Qian Mingwu took a deep breath and said in a trembled voice, "Those martial artists were just thrown in alive, and used other weird materials to refine them into human pill!
Jing Qian also has an unusually perverted and brutal hobby. Every time he refines a human pill, he prefers beautiful girls! "
"Jing Qianyi's crimes are simply too numerous to write, and they are hard to count!
Ji Ruxue clenched her small fist angrily, "Even if he died 10,000 painful deaths, it would not be enough to make up for his sin!"
"When things are done here, I will turn this manor upside down!"
"I want to uncover Jing Qianyi's polite mask of hypocrisy, so that he will be cast aside by the world and restless!"
Su Lang smiled faintly, then turned to look at Qian Mingwu, "By the way, where did his victims who used it in alchemy come from?"
"Part of it was coaxed by himself."
"Some of them were sent by the people of the Ji family, all of them are geniuses with top quality!"
Qian Mingwu swallowed a spit and said, "The Ji family and Jing Qianyi are embarrassed, and many of their family have taken Ren Dan!
I estimate that there are dozens or hundreds of human pills that the Ji family has eaten, and each one represents the life of a vivid genius!
If the non-human pill can only be taken once, and it is invalid for the best qualifications, more geniuses will die for this! "
"Ji family..."
"The dignified Wuwang family, not only does not want to resist the fierce beasts, but also kills the same clan. It is an unforgivable sin.
"One day, I will erase it from this world abruptly!"
"Every guy involved in Rendan will suffer the same cruel punishment as Jing Qianye!"
Su Lang's voice was as cold as it came from the ice hell.
Qian Mingwu bowed and said, "Master Ruo Su can use it, and I would like to be the forerunner!"
"forget it."
"To destroy the Ji family, I can do it alone."
Su Lang waved his hand and smiled, "Your top priority is to protect your family.
After this is done, you will take your family away from Eastern City, wait until the storm subsides, and then come back. "
"Ugh!"
"I only hate my low cultivation base and shallow strength."
Qian Mingwu sighed regretfully, "Can't follow Master Su Lang, and kill the Ji family thief!"
"Haha, you can uphold your righteousness and kill other villains."
Su Lang laughed and said, "Don't tell me, take me to find the treasure Jing Qianyi is hiding."
"Yes!"
Qian Mingwu also smiled, and then continued to lead the way.
After a while, a group of people appeared outside a secret vault with a closed door.
"Master Su Lang!"
"This secret library has a powerful formation guard, and it requires a key to open it."
Qian Mingwu respectfully said: "The key is in Jing Qianyi's space ring, and it is a white dragon seal.
Put the seal on the door and open the door! "
"Ok!"
Su Lang glanced at the storage space and quickly found the key.
According to the method Qian Mingwu said, Su Lang successfully opened the door to the secret library.
"Huh!"
A piece of golden light and jade appeared in front of everyone!
Looking around, there are everything you need for spirit stones, genius treasures, and weapons!
"Hey, it's all mine!"
Su Lang showed excitement, and with a big wave of his hand, he packed all the items into the storage space!

Qian Mingwu swallowed a spit and said, "The Ji family and Jing Qianyi are embarrassed, and many of their family have taken Ren Dan!
I estimate that there are dozens or hundreds of human pills that the Ji family has eaten, and each one represents the life of a vivid genius!
If the non-human pill can only be taken once, and it is invalid for the best qualifications, more geniuses will die for this!
"Ji family..."
"The dignified Wuwang family, not only does not want to resist the fierce beasts, but also kills the same clan.
It is an unforgivable sin.
"One day, I will erase it from this world abruptly!"
"Every guy involved in Rendan will suffer the same cruel punishment as Jing Qianye!"
Su Lang's voice was as cold as it came from the ice hell.
Qian Mingwu bowed and said, "Master Ruo Su can use it, and I would like to be the forerunner!"
"forget it."
"To destroy the Ji family, I can do it alone."
Su Lang waved his hand and smiled, "Your top priority is to protect your family.
After this is done, you will take your family away from Eastern City, wait until the storm subsides, and then come back.
"Ugh!"
"I only hate my low cultivation base and shallow strength."
Qian Mingwu sighed regretfully, "Can't follow Master Su Lang, and kill the Ji family thief!"
"Haha, you can uphold your righteousness and kill other villains."
Su Lang laughed and said, "Don't tell me, take me to find the treasure Jing Qianyi is hiding."
"Yes!"
Qian Mingwu also smiled, and then continued to lead the way.
After a while, a group of people appeared outside a secret vault with a closed door.
"Master Su Lang!"
"This secret library has a powerful formation guard, and it requires a key to open it."
Qian Mingwu respectfully said: "The key is in Jing Qianyi's space ring, and it is a white dragon seal.
Put the seal on the door and open the door!
"Ok!"
Su Lang glanced at the storage space and quickly found the key.
According to the method Qian Mingwu said, Su Lang successfully opened the door to the secret library.
"Huh!"
A piece of golden light and jade appeared in front of everyone!
Looking around, there are everything you need for spirit stones, genius treasures, and weapons!
"Hey, it's all mine!"
Su Lang showed excitement, and with a big wave of his hand, he packed all the items into the storage space!

chapters.title: Chapter 172: One hundred and twenty million low-grade spirit stones!
paragraphs: "Ding! You get low-grade spiritual stones*2361256, middle-grade spiritual stones*323223, high-grade spiritual stones*2656..."
"Tsk tusk, it's another spiritual stone worth 3 billion gold coins!"
"Moreover, there are various alchemy materials, heavenly materials and earth treasures, and alchemy classics!"
Su Lang's face was filled with excitement that was hard to hide.
Immediately, he immediately stored these spirit stones into the system.
In an instant, the balance of the low-grade spirit stones in the system soared to a terrifying nine-digit number-123467757!
"Hahaha! Over 120 million lower-grade spirit stones!"
"The system, first upgrade me the avatar dispatch, one-click treasure hunting function!"
Su Lang was so excited that he immediately issued the upgrade order!
"Ding! Consuming 10 million lower-grade spirit stones, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 8, and the number of clones +1"

"Ding! Consume 10 million lower-grade spirit stones, the one-click treasure hunting function has been upgraded to level 8, and the number of treasure hunting flying flying gliders has increased to 256"
In an instant, a small purple figure condensed in the mysterious black space again.
At this time, the number of Su Lang's clones had reached a full eight, each with the same powerful abilities as him!
This made his real combat power invisibly improved, I don't know how much!
At the same time, the number of treasure hunting flying gliders doubled, which brought great benefits to Su Lang.
After turning on the one-key alchemy function, Su Lang's alchemy materials were always in short supply.
The one-click treasure hunt has been upgraded, and the collected materials have been directly doubled, which invisibly doubled his income from alchemy!
"Good!
"And there are more than 100 million lower-grade spirit stones that are useless!"
Su Lang's eyes flashed with intense excitement, "System, upgrade the one-key training function!"
"Ding! The amount of funds currently consumed to upgrade the system is too large, and the current unit'low-grade spirit stone' has been replaced with'medium-grade spirit stone."
"Ding! Consumption of 1 million middle-grade spirit stones, the one-key training function is upgraded to level 10, and the training speed is increased to 1024 times the basic speed!"
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the one-key training function to level 10. You have obtained the bonus function "Spirit Sea", which can start spiritual training!"
"Noisy, noisy! Spiritual cultivation!"
"Isn't this a special practice that King Wu can perform?"
Su Lang's eyes suddenly burst into an astonishing light.
The spirit is even more important than the physical existence!
After a strong mental power, it can bring a lot of benefits, and mental perception alone can be infinitely useful.
In addition, having a strong mental power can control a stronger body and stronger attribute energy!
Even mental power can be directly used as an offensive method, directly attacking the enemy's soul, which is simply impossible to defend.
When the enemy's spirit is much weaker than you, and there is no mental protection, you can even kill the opponent with a single glance!
This is simply staring at everyone, so awesome!
Of course, spiritual training is not that simple.
It is even more difficult to cultivate your spirit to the point where you can kill with one thought!
First of all, the martial artist must reach the rank of the king of martial arts before he can actively cultivate spiritual power.
But how many people can become King Wu?
There are only seven or eight Ji family who almost cover the sky in Eastern City!
Therefore, just becoming King Wu will stump most people.
Secondly, spiritual cultivation also requires qualifications.
It can be said that the spiritual aptitude of the vast majority of King Wu is not good.
It is very difficult for them to maintain the normal mental strength in their current state.
Even some Wu Wang's spiritual aptitude is too bad, and can only passively rely on the flesh and treasures to nourish and strengthen the spirit.
As a result, the speed of mental power increase is simply heartbreakingly slow.
And if the mental strength is backward, it will drag down the breakthrough of the cultivation realm.
This shows how difficult and important it is to practice spiritual cultivation.
However, for the current Su Lang, spiritual training is completely easy.
As long as he wants to, he can start spiritual cultivation anytime!
Moreover, the training speed is the same as the one-key training function, which is 1024 times that of the unqualified genius!
"This is really going to make me burst into flames!"
Su Lang was so excited that he took a cold breath, his fingers trembled, "System, immediately start my spiritual cultivation!"

chapters.title: Chapter 173: Start spiritual training!
paragraphs: "boom!!"
There was a turmoil in Su Lang's mind.
A strange white halo suddenly condensed in the black spiritual consciousness.
Thousands of silk ribbons hung from the white halo, rippling endlessly, and finally merged into the dark spiritual consciousness.
But after a closer look, you can find that those thousands of silk ribbons are leached from the dark spiritual consciousness, and then absorbed by the white halo!
At the same time, a white halo suddenly appeared in the back of the white villain who represented automatic cultivation.
A large amount of information flooded into his mind, and Su Lang immediately understood.
It turns out that when the white halo completely turns golden, it is the time when the spiritual power is advanced!
Through a certain exercise method, Su Lang learned of the three levels of mental power-mind, fog, and mind.
They correspond to the normal mental power levels of the three powerful realms of Wuwang, Wuhuang, and Wuzun.
As for the higher levels, he has not seen any descriptions from any exercises.
And his spiritual power level at this time is the state of mind!
In this realm, you can already use your mental power to detect the environment within a radius of hundreds of kilometers!
Within this range, almost nothing is visible, any movement can't escape the detection of mental power.
But beyond this range, it is like having myopia of thousands of degrees, the further the distance is, the more blurred, and finally nothing can be seen.
"Let me see how clearly I can see!
A tick at the corner of Su Lang's mouth radiated out his spiritual power, and immediately the entire underground space was printed into the sea of consciousness, which was extremely clear.
"This ability to control the surrounding movement is truly a sense of security!"
Su Lang took a deep breath, "Unfortunately, the current level of mental power is too low to affect reality, unable to defend things, let alone kill.
However, if I complete the first mental power breakthrough, my mental power level will be the foggy realm!
By then, you will be able to show more wonderful abilities! "
Thinking of this, Su Lang looked forward to it: "System, how long will it take me to be promoted to a higher level of spiritual power?"
"Ding! Host, your mental power can break through to the fogging realm in just 7 days!"
"Jie Jie Jie Jie!"
"According to the description in that exercise method, it will take at least decades for ordinary Wu Wang to cultivate his spiritual power to the fogging state!"
Su Lang's eyes couldn't help showing an extremely excited look:
"And me, it only takes 7 days! It's worthy of a training speed of 1024 times, so cool!"
"Brother Su Lang!"
"Are we leaving here next?"
Ji Ruxue looked at Su Lang with doubts. She didn't know why Su Lang was in a daze again. It was really bad...
Granny Ke and Qian Mingwu didn't know why Su Lang was in a daze, but they didn't dare to ask at all.
"Aha, yeah, I'm leaving here."
Su Lang laughed, "But before we leave, we have to leave some gifts for the bad guys of the Ji family!
"What gift?"
Ji Ruxue asked curiously.
"I said it before!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "I'm going to turn this place upside down, let this sinful place bask in the sun, and let everyone know the bad things that the Ji family did secretly."
"So it is!"
Ji Ruxue nodded heavily, "Then Brother Su Lang, do it!"
"Ok!"
Su Lang smiled slightly and waved his big hand. Eight clones appeared in eight directions in the underground space.
"Giant body forging tactics!!"
Su Lang's heart moved, and the eight clones immediately used the secret technique of the Giant God's Bodybuilding Secret Art.
I saw their bodies swell wildly, and in a blink of an eye they reached a giant of ten meters!
The clothes on their bodies were also broken.
Of course, Su Lang used the black flame of the falling sun to cover it, and there is no such thing as going out.
Looking at the eight giants over three stories tall in front of them, the three Ji Ruxue were all shocked and shocked!
This is definitely one of the most unforgettable scenes they have seen in their lives!
